items.question: In the UAE, must a vehicle produced in the last three years pass the pre-registration inspection at an authorised testing centre?
items.gold: No, vehicles produced in the last three years before registration are exempt from the inspection.
items.fact: Vehicles produced within last three years are exempt from pre-registration inspection.

items.question: Which documents does a company need to provide when registering a vehicle in the UAE, besides the vehicle document and Emirates ID?
items.gold: An official letter in Arabic, a copy of the trade licence, endorsement of signature, and an authorisation letter.
items.fact: Company vehicle registration requires four specific supporting documents listed.
